message.content: Pick one of the provided functions to fulfill the following command: Change the point 'pointA' to 2,3,4

function.name: set_integer
function.description: Sets the value of an integer variable specified by its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique identifier for the integer variable.

value.description: The value to assign to the integer variable.

function.name: set_string
function.description: Assigns a new value to the specified string variable. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

string_name.description: The identifier of the string variable to be updated.

string_value.description: The new content that the string variable will hold.

function.name: set_float
function.description: Assigns a floating-point number to the specified variable. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

number_name.description: The identifier for the floating-point variable.

number_value.description: The floating-point value to be assigned to the variable. This is a float type value.

function.name: set_point
function.description: Sets a point in 3D space with given X, Y, and Z coordinates and assigns it a name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x.description: The X coordinate of the point in units. This is a float type value.

y.description: The Y coordinate of the point in units. This is a float type value.

z.description: The Z coordinate of the point in units. This is a float type value.

point_name.description: The unique name assigned to the point.
